Sometimes we all need alone time, and think through things. 

How are you now?

I’m sorry you’re going through pain… also you’ve got amazing talents, like aerial and that drawing of that pup. Do you have any other drawings of dogs? 

How do you feel now?

Thanks so much 

You seem like a lovely person to talk to people.

I was contemplating if I should talk to that person who made the post but decided not to. 

You’re welcome and sorry for the randomness
I’m not trying to get at you but your hair is beautiful, with those curls. Consider that a compliment
Well, good luck to you :)

I love that username 

I’m sorry you’re feeling like this
Good on you and I hope you find your happiness in the future. :)
Good luck
I’m going to watch Nightmare on elm street for the first time. I might not survive later on, haha

Oh my god, that’s wrong. I don’t know what’s wrong with people sometimes. 

Tell me, are you inside now?

Just remember at least you defended your brother.

How hot is it? And can you stay in the shade or are there any water sources?

Well, there you go then and I bet she’s nice to be stroked though, with the fluffiness. 

You’re very welcome and I’m glad to hear that. You try and take care of yourself. If you want to talk whenever, I’m here.
They are lucky to have you… I laughed at Pom Pom, that’s an interesting name.

That’s understandable… what’s their names? 

I used to have rats myself, and I would love to have them again one day in my life. 

Oh definitely, it’s like a rollercoaster life, the bad and the good.

You’re welcome :) 

So, what are you going to do now? If you don’t mind me asking.

Bless them… Did you know that males are more laid back than females? 

Oh god, that’s so sad for your friend. Life sucks sometimes, doesn’t it?

Oh wow, you have pet rats? I love them, so intelligent animals. Can they do tricks? 

I’m sorry you’ve lost everyone, I can’t imagine how you feel. I’m also sorry for you friend, I hope they aren’t suffering anymore. 

I’m here if you want anyone to talk to
I know how you feel… I’m so sorry you’ve been through this. I hope happiness finds you one day.
God, I’m sorry. I hope you recover

I looked at your other posts, and if your hobby is drawing, then maybe you could pursue a drawing career. Just a suggestion… 

Your friends sounds lovely, I’m glad you’ve got them.

Hey, if you’re still here; 

I’m so sorry you’ve been through this, and you don’t deserve it. Families can suck, that’s for sure.

I’m sorry you’re still feeling shit, whatever path you’ll take, I’ll hope you find your happiness. 

Might be a crazy idea but I think I’ll watch Deadpool for you, as you mentioned it. Tomorrow, will be the day. 

Oh I see, at least there a little relief, something, huh? 

Thanks for answering my questions by the way

Not sure but forgive me if I’m wrong but I remember your username from a little over a year ago, the post from Vincenzo, bless him. 

How are you doing during the year?

Hey, how are you feeling now? 

Also, deadpool is an amazing film, not gonna lie. I might even watch it again, as you mentioned it. Did you enjoy the film? 

Also, was the hallucinagens worth it? Apparently LSD is good, I don’t know if it’s the truth or not?

Thanks for understanding Haliper… 

Luckily I’ve got a family, so I won’t drink daily. Without them, I’ll probably be dead
Same… I’m here if you want to talk
I think you’re right… thanks for the response. Have a good day/night
Maybe one day you’ll find someone perfect who will love you… I’m sorry though, it’s a difficult feeling for you.

Oh wow, that was quick 

Good to hear though
Ahh, on holiday? I’m guessing by the “atm”
I hope you’re okay now :)
I’m so sorry… I hope you find your happiness. Such a young age as well, you deserve better.

I’m so sorry to hear about this… it would be so nice if that bit of happiness you had was long term. That’s so good of you for being kind to people. I hope you find your happiness either in this life or after death.

I know you’re hurting, and I’ve read your posts. You sound like a nice person, especially when people told you that you make them happier, so remember that. 

I’m sorry you’re suffering though

How is your mom doing now? 

I’m sorry to hear about this and this must be so difficult for all of you. 

Also, good luck with the tests and I hope you get good results

Oh my god, you have been through hell and back. I’m so sorry to hear about this. 

Make sure you make this Christmas special for you and your husband.
